## Change checklist

- [ ] `go test ./...` passes locally (the project's declared test command)
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests, including at least one failure-case test
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased`
- [ ] Docs affected by this change are updated (README, docs/, ADRs when a decision was made)
- [ ] No hardcoded Vikunja endpoint knowledge was added to the command layer
- [ ] PR body follows this template
